name: caller-principal-python-post-edit-refuses-an-absent-principal
description: post-edit commits a version and records last_writer_id under the named session. The first preflight CLAIMS session A; its pre-edit (accept-class) is admitted without the principal, but the commit naming the now-bound A without it is refused. Enforcement is accident-resistance under the same-OS-user cooperative trust model, not caller separation: on the hook surface the principal is stored under .coherence/.

body.error: missing Coherence-Caller-Principal header: this route requires the caller principal that POST /principal/claim bound to the session_id it names (caller_principal_absent)
